serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
'Nun' Shanice: Welcome back! 
You: So, any progress with repairs?
'Nun' Shanice: I got to his interiors easily, even opening the US voting machine is harder.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: What he had inside changed my perception of Church a little bit though…
You: W-what did you find?
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: Nothing! Don’t worry about it! Let’s just say I’m a little bit safer when going back home at night. 
Huh? What was that all about.
She said that I shouldn’t worry about it so let’s just ignore this.
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
You: Alright then. More importantly, did you find the cause of him getting broken?
'Nun' Shanice: It’s not on the hardware part, I can tell you that.
